title: Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron earnings show increased DRAM prices, not shipments, indicating a focus on revenue over helping clients get the products they need (Tim Culpan/Culpium)
summary: Tim Culpan / Culpium: Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron earnings show increased DRAM prices, not shipments, indicating a focus on revenue over helping clients get the products they need — [Opinion] The AI sector will finally get the chips it needs, but everyone else will continue hurting for years to come
